patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I've had a nasty cough for days, bringing up green gunk, and now it hurts to take a deep breath on my right side. I've been feverish and totally wiped out.
clinical.presentationShort: 55yo M ? several days of productive cough, right pleuritic chest pain, fever 38.9?C, focal right-sided crackles and egophony, SpO2 94%.
clinical.presentationLong: 55-year-old male with several days of productive cough, fever, fatigue, and right-sided pain on deep inspiration. He has focal right-sided crackles and egophony, respiratory rate 22, and oxygen saturation 94%.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → chest X-ray, labs, antibiotics, oxygen if needed; risk-stratify (CURB-65) for admit vs. home.
diagnosis.why: Productive cough + focal pleuritic pain + fever + crackles = pneumonia. CXR confirms; CURB-65 guides disposition.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, one hand on his right chest, mid-cough
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 55-year-old man, flushed and feverish, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: seated, one hand pressed to his right chest as if mid-cough. Expression: tired and unwell. Clearly visible: a hand on the right side of the chest and a flushed, feverish face. No text, no logos.
